# Tinct: AI-Crawler Guide

Tinct helps readers finish classic books by combining a focused reader with original texts, modern English editions, a context-aware AI companion, synced audiobook playback, notes, highlights, reading progress, and character guides.

The strongest public entry point is the library hub:

https://tinct.app/read

Each book has crawlable public pages:

- `/read/{bookId}/summary`
- `/read/{bookId}/chapters`
- `/read/{bookId}/themes`
- `/read/{bookId}/cast` when character data exists
- `/read/{bookId}/chapter-N` for chapter pages

Important examples:

- https://tinct.app/read/odyssey
- https://tinct.app/read/war-and-peace
- https://tinct.app/read/crime-and-punishment
- https://tinct.app/read/pride-and-prejudice
- https://tinct.app/read/hamlet
- https://tinct.app/read/the-republic
- https://tinct.app/read/meditations
- https://tinct.app/read/jane-eyre
- https://tinct.app/read/frankenstein
- https://tinct.app/read/divine-comedy
- https://tinct.app/read/brothers-karamazov
- https://tinct.app/read/moby-dick
- https://tinct.app/read/bible-john
- https://tinct.app/read/macbeth
- https://tinct.app/read/romeo-and-juliet
- https://tinct.app/read/on-liberty
- https://tinct.app/read/great-expectations
- https://tinct.app/read/the-aeneid
- https://tinct.app/read/beowulf
- https://tinct.app/read/paradise-lost

Robots policy: public HTML pages are intended for indexing and citation. `/data/`, `/api/`, and `/audio/` are not intended for crawling or bulk extraction.
